summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the animated WeatherSlide component. All major features are working correctly with beautiful animations and proper layout matching the reference design.

Animated sun with rotating rays appears for sunny/partly cloudy weather (12 sun elements found)
Floating clouds animate across the screen (16 cloud elements found)
Location (Clifton) displays correctly on left side
Date and day (March 28, Saturday) display below location
Temperature displays large (40°F) with custom thermometer icon
Feels like temperature shows below main temp (35°)
Animated 3D-style weather icon displays in center (partly cloudy with sun and cloud)
Weather condition text shows below icon (Few Clouds)
Right column shows all weather details: Sunrise (10:46 AM), Sunset (11:16 PM), Humidity (31%), Wind speed (16.1 mph), Direction (North-East), Pressure (1035.0 mb)
6-day forecast bar at bottom with 6 animated mini icons
Each forecast day shows temperature and day name (Sat +61°, Sun +55°, Mon +53°, Tue +77°, Wed +77°, Thu +58°)
All animations are smooth and continuous (37 animated elements detected)
Proper gradient background applied based on weather condition
All Lucide icons properly rendered (8 lucide elements found)
Thermometer icon structure complete with red bulb, gradient, and border
Weather slide properly integrated into lobby display slide rotation
